Cross-platform CI validation scripts that enforce repository governance rules before merge.
profile-command.mjs: Compact timing wrapper for local and CI verification commands; writes sanitized duration and exit metadata without command arguments or environment values.
select-affected-tests.mjs: Fail-closed changed-path selector for local verification and observational CI summaries; unknown or critical paths expand to the full safe suite.
select-affected-tests.test.mjs: Deterministic regression tests for affected-test mapping, path normalization and full-fallback safety.
validate-agent-instructions.mjs: Validates active AGENTS instruction chains, byte budgets, local links, override precedence and generated CLAUDE.md parity.
validate-agent-instructions.test.mjs: Isolated regression tests for agent instruction discovery, budgets, links and compatibility-copy drift.
validate-agent-ui-boundaries.js: Node.js validator for ADR-044 Agent UI import boundaries: CopilotKit and AG-UI imports are allowed only in approved adapter files.
validate-prototype-audit-status.js: Node.js validator for ADR-050 prototype audit status records emitted by the weekly audit workflow.
validate-runtime-api-openapi.js: Node.js validator for ADR-051 runtime-api OpenAPI contract shape, endpoint drift and future extraction spec classification.
validate-legacy.js: Node.js validator for legacy debt rows, stub register consistency, stub marker governance and .desc.json parsing.
validate-legacy.ps1: PowerShell wrapper that delegates legacy/stub validation to the cross-platform Node.js validator.
validate-manifest-authoring.js: Node.js validator for ADR-030 authoring manifest compilation, generated drift and authoring-only key leakage.
